title: Relating Changing Quantities
lookahead: Functions describe how one quantity changes with another. Average rate of change (LF1) is the idea calculus sharpens into the derivative.

title: Circular Functions
lookahead: Angles, radians, and the unit circle turn turning motion into functions. Calculus measures angles in radians, which is why they come first.

title: Continuous Growth with Exponential and Logarithmic Functions
lookahead: Exponential and logarithmic functions model growth and decay. The number e shows up because it makes continuous growth simplest to describe, and calculus uses it everywhere.

title: Trigonometry and Triangles in Motion
lookahead: More trig functions, their inverses, identities, and solving triangles. Identities are rewriting tools you will use often in calculus.

title: Polynomial and Rational Functions
lookahead: Zeros, end behavior, asymptotes, and inequalities. Asymptotes and end behavior are a first look at limits.

title: Foundational Fluency
lookahead: The algebra and geometry skills every chapter leans on. Build them any week, not just at the start.
